fact: The IMF staff report of 26 June 2025 says Chad launched e-tax for online declaration and payment of corporate taxes, e-payment of customs taxes started in 2024, and a prior action requires e-payment of taxes, fees and duties through banks and mobile operators (met by circular 004 of 3 July 2025).
title: Chad: Request for a Four-Year Arrangement Under the Extended Credit Facility, IMF Country Report No. 25/236
